edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails

  Scenario: AC6 Business rules BR1 to BR10 hold (new; architecture constraints)
    Given the schema, the workflow inputs and the logs of this service are in place
    When the boundary test runs
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 holds and the build fails if one does not

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations (new)
    Given a request to a provided operation without a credential, without the Asset and disposal right, or for a case that is not found
    When the request is made
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 and no read and no write happens

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout (new; X8)
    Given a consumed contract misses 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the activity runs
    Then the activity is retried on the workflow schedule and the answer is 503 in the platform envelope when the retry fails

  Scenario: AC9 Consumed call fails or does not answer (new)
    Given a consumed contract call fails or does not answer
    When the call is made
    Then nothing is written and the term does not start
